MktCalcInsightObjectDef.expression: SELECT Account_Total_Revenue__cio.account_id__c AS Account_ID__c, MAX(Account_Total_Revenue__cio.Total_Revenue__c) AS Account_Revenue__c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY MAX(Account_Total_Revenue__cio.Total_Revenue__c) DESC ) AS revenue_rank__c FROM Account_Total_Revenue__cio GROUP BY Account_Total_Revenue__cio.account_id__c
